Sparse Voxel DAG compression This repo is used for experimenting with SVDAG compression techniques for my MSc thesis. The source code of Symmetry-aware Sparse Voxel DAGs is used as a foundation. It includes A lossy compression format (LSVDAG) that clusters similar nodes together.
